messages:
sara: FYI i pushed a small console feature in sandbox: admins can edit feature-flag cache TTLs from the UI. goal: faster ops during incidents but i want a quick safety review before enabling in prod

miguel: can you paste the flow? who can edit, and does it affect live snapshots?

sara: only admins for now. UI has two radio options: "apply to new snapshots only" (safer) or "apply to active snapshots" (immediate). currently default is active snapshots but i'm going to flip that unless we decide otherwise.

tarun: telemetry requirements: emit event `flag.ttl.change` with flag_id, old_ttl, new_ttl, actor, trace_id. also increment counter `flag.ttl.updates_total` and tag by env.

emily-dx: UX: show a 7-day sparkline of cache hit-rate + avg latency next to the TTL editor so people can see recent impact before changing. require a mandatory checkbox for "I understand this may affect cache hits and latency".

sara: good. i'll add the checkbox and the sparkline.

jess-runbooks: runbook: if cache hit-rate increases >15% vs baseline in 5m, revert TTL to previous value and clear prefix cache. also notify the flag owner and oncall. can deploy-bot create a revert suggestion?

deploy-bot: created task #6219: "ttl-regression-revert-suggestion" with checklist template. (automated) :white_check_mark:

miguel: api note: require optimistic locking on TTL PATCH. use If-Match with etag and return 412 on mismatch. snippet:
```
PATCH /api/v1/flags/:id
Headers: If-Match: "<etag>"
Body: { "ttl_seconds": 900, "apply_to_active_snapshots": false }
```

tarun: also sample 1/1000 requests with header `x-flag-ttl-snapshot` containing the active ttl to help debugging. add derived metric `cache.prefix_hit_rate_by_flag` and a temporary alert rule: if metric increases by >15% over 5m then fire pager to ops (severity: low) and open a suggestive revert.

emily-dx: console: add timeline entries for TTL edits (who/when/why) and a rollback button that pre-fills the previous TTL + clears cache if allowed.

sara: i'll implement: 1) default to "new snapshots only"; 2) emit `flag.ttl.change` event and counter; 3) add sparkline + checkbox + timeline; 4) optimistic locking; 5) sampling header; 6) wire alert prototype. i'll push to staging tomorrow afternoon and ask for a 15m quick-check.

jess-runbooks: i'll draft the rollback playbook and notification text now.

miguel: tiny add: when generating the TTL event include `recent_deploy_id` if there's a deploy in the last 20m so we can correlate.

sara: noted. will update sandbox and post the staging link here. thanks all :pray:
